name: 可回收等待许可的前缀和一次补读尾段
rule: Shared immutable pool backs both logical DMA token queues and optional history. No duplicate payload write at normal granted R handshake.
Soft future refs may borrow unused cells beyond guarantee; actual noncancelable ingress/lookup/heldR/committed/FIFO/spill hardrefs are charged to guarantee.

On mandatory request demand, remove highest-offset unpublished optional-only refs to preserve a retained prefix. Do not reclaim any other hard owner; normal RVALID freezes data and token before READY.
Normal successful physicalAR accepts originalID/span; only actual granted normalR handshake converts ref to committedDMA token and advances source counter.
Issue sole suffixAR only at actual first missing unserved cursor; freeze firstVALID, stay in miss mode through originalRLAST and all originalW/B/ACK; no reread of served words.

hand_counts.scope: N8,V/AQ3, sharedpoolP6; illustrative one-word-at-time V stream, late correct Agrant
hand_counts.complete_same_pool_control: implements both exact token transition and elastic p5; no exclusive readcount difference.
hand_counts.pressure_neighbor: AconsumedR0+heldR1 and newV3 mandatory need trims4/3; firstmissingAoffset3, one suffix5; heldR1 unchanged.
hand_counts.not_cycles: read beat counts from finite hand events, not native/FPGA timing.

proof_boundary: P=sumQ with each real hardref charged: an issuer with unused guarantee cannot be blocked by entirely hard-fullpool; a fullpool then contains reclaimableoptional-onlycell. Do not use false hardcapacity stall as the positive.
costs: 6payloadcells384bits both unifiedcandidate and ordinarysamepool. Tokenlists/generations/provenance, lookup read lease/kill retry, normalRDATA andW poolread ports, descriptor/sourcecursor, originalR/W staging and paid cuts remain common costs; totalLUT/BRAM/timing unknown.
decision: Adopt as explicit simple architecture baseline and protocol specification. Because samepool control reproduces the rule and prior already covers unified references/partialretention, do not claim borrowing/refcount or9to6alone as independent innovation.
